title: Kagura's Dreamland 神樂夢境
description:
A cute, joyful, and casual light adventure, welcome to Kagura's Dreamland!
Fantasy World of a High School GirlKagura's Dreamland contains 16 adventure levels plus 3 special levels, totaling 19 maps with different features for players to explore. On the way, players will go through forests, deserts, snowfields, gorges, etc., encounter different monsters, learn new skills, and defeat the ultimate enemy.

You can collect crystals on the map and trade them for more powerful weapons to face more dangerous challenges. In addition, after rounds of battle, Kagura's level will increase, allowing her to perform more powerful attacks.Unbearably cute little creatures!These little bears and kittens are so cute that it's a shame you have to fight them in your dreams. But don't worry, no little creatures are harmed in these dreams.
Refreshing MusicEach level is accompanied by relaxing music, which is different from the tense action games, and Kagura is only enjoyable along the way.
Farm in WonderlandThe pets of Kagura have been lost in the dream world, traverse various levels and bring them back to the farm in wonderland.
description_short: Enter Kagura's Dreamland and pass through each level to defeat your dark ego.Each dream is accompanied by delightful music, and on the way, you will meet cute bears, kittens, Slimes, etc., and fight with them in an imaginary battle.
